PPO INTERVIEW
MORGAN STANLEY
ARCHEEL PAREKH, B.Tech. CE 2018-22
There was only 1 round for PPO interviews
60 mins
1. Introduction and discussion on internship project (10 mins)
Asked me to explain my project, how it will be useful for the
firm, and what were my learnings.
2. Resume based questions (10 mins)
Projects on my resume had flutter and AgoraRTC used so
interviewer asked about those projects (Interviewer had used
those technologies and was familiar with them)
○How would you implement a navigation bar in flutter?
○Questions on AgoraRTC and webRTC
3. Non Coding Questions (5 mins)
○Questions on multithreading and its use, how threads
communicate in java? Thread vs Process? What will happen
to child threads when the parent process is killed?
4. Coding Questions (30 mins)
○Write a C++ generic class/function to add two strings or two
integers.
○Error handling code in C++
○What if you return from the catch block? Does the finally
block execute? What will happen to the return statement in
the finally block?
○Coin Change
○Longest common prefix
5. Coding Questions (5 mins)
